programs.name: sunomstreamers
programs.purpose: Create or update traces with nominal towed-streamer geometry and inline CDP numbers.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUNOMSTREAMERS - Nominal Geometry and 2D CDPS for Towed-Streamer Marine.

params.name: shotspacing
params.description: Positive inline distance between shot numbers.

params.name: gunkey
params.description: Header used to select the firing gun array.

params.name: guninline
params.description: One inline offset or one per gun.

params.name: streamerinline
params.description: One inline offset or one per streamer.

params.name: streamerkey
params.description: Streamer identifier header; required when streameridnt is specified.

params.name: idntkey
params.description: Undocumented parameter checked only when streameridnt is absent; specifying it triggers an error.

params.name: streameridnt
params.description: Streamer identifiers; required when using streamerkey.

params.name: channelstart
params.description: First channel number, either one value or one per streamer.

params.name: channelend
params.description: Last channel number, either one value or one per streamer.

params.name: channelspacing
params.description: One channel spacing or one per streamer.

params.name: cdpspacing
params.default: computed: half the minimum channel spacing
params.description: Nominal inline CDP spacing; zero leaves CDP unchanged.

params.name: offpi
params.description: Offset mode: unchanged, inline, or Pythagorean.

params.name: linelocs
params.description: Set gun, streamer, shot and channel line-location headers.

params.name: scalco
params.description: Coordinate scaling; zero leaves coordinates unchanged.

params.name: create
params.description: Number of shots to create; zero processes input traces.

params.name: spikes
params.description: Time/amplitude pairs for created traces, or one integer selecting an input trace to replicate; absent creates one zero sample at 4 ms.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Geometry uses double arithmetic, fmod, sqrt and lrint, while spike times and amplitudes use float. Rounding mode, transcendental results, and conversion to integer headers can affect exact output.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program expands and validates a multi-source, multi-streamer layout and maintains state while processing or creating traces.

test_cases.description: Update generated traces with inline offsets and preserve coordinates.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=16 ntr=4 | sushw key=fldr,tracf a=1,1 b=0,1 | sunomstreamers shotspacing=25 gunid=0 guncross=0 guninline=-10 streamercross=0 streamerinline=-100 channelstart=1 channelend=4 channelspacing=12.5 offpi=1 scalco=0 > out.su

test_cases.description: Create shots and replicate a generated input trace.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=32 ntr=1 k1=8 | sunomstreamers shotspacing=25 gunid=0 guncross=0 guninline=-10 streamercross=0 streamerinline=-100 channelstart=1 channelend=4 channelspacing=12.5 create=2 firstshot=2 spikes=1 > out.su

programs.name: suprofcsv
programs.purpose: Build a smoothed and interpolated profile from command-line values or a Q-file and write a Q-file.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPROFCSV - Input Q-file or parameters, make profile, output other Q-file.

params.name: qin
params.description: Input Q-file; absent selects command-line input.

params.name: qout
params.description: Output Q-file; code passes its value to fopen without a separate missing-parameter check.

params.name: chordi
params.description: Initial chord spacing; zero disables initial chording.

params.name: chordf
params.description: Final chord spacing; zero disables final chording.

params.name: shiftrec
params.description: Q-record numbers at which shifts are specified.

params.name: point_cru
params.description: CDPs per point unit for the first CDP.

params.name: cdp
params.description: Command-line non-tuple location values; at least one non-tuple name is required without qin.

params.name: gaps
params.description: Command-line non-tuple values, normally point numbers.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Double-precision distance calculations use sqrt, interpolation and running sums; accumulation order, lrint and formatted decimal output affect exact results. Several string allocations omit space for the terminating NUL, causing buffer overflows and undefined behavior.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program sorts and buffers profile records and applies several interpolation, averaging and smoothing stages.

test_cases.description: Create a straight profile from parameter arrays.
test_cases.command: suprofcsv qout=profile.q gaps=1,2,3,4,5,6 gx=0,25,50,75,100,125 gy=0,0,0,0,0,0 chordi=25 chordf=25 nmaxa=0 nmaxs=0

test_cases.description: Read and smooth an existing generated Q-file.
test_cases.command: suprofcsv qout=in.q gaps=1,2,3,4,5,6 gx=0,25,50,75,100,125 gy=0,1,3,3,1,0 chordi=0 chordf=0 nmaxa=0 nmaxs=0 && suprofcsv qin=in.q qout=out.q chordi=0 chordf=0 nmaxa=1 nmaxs=1

programs.license_note: The credits state that the program started from subinqcsv.

programs.name: surange
programs.purpose: Report trace-header ranges and coordinate extents for an SU stream.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SURANGE - get max and min values for non-zero header entries

params.name: key
params.description: Header keys to range; absent ranges all keys.

params.name: dim
params.description: Report line dimensions in feet for 1 or metres for 2.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Coordinate scaling, midpoint distances, sqrt and cumulative distance use double arithmetic. With only one trace, the last-header values remain zero-initialized; signal handling and reopening input are platform dependent.
programs.difficulty_reason: It streams traces and maintains header extrema and coordinate statistics.

test_cases.command: sunull nt=16 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp,offset a=1,100 b=1,25 | surange key=cdp,offset

test_cases.description: Calculate coordinate extents and metric line dimensions.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=16 ntr=8 | sushw key=sx,gx,sy,gy a=100,120,10,10 b=25,25,0,0 | surange dim=2

programs.license_note: Credits identify contributions from Arkansas, Stanford, Geocon and SEP, as well as CWP.

programs.name: susehw
programs.purpose: Set a trace number within each consecutive ensemble identified by a header.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSEHW - Set the value the Header Word denoting trace number within

params.name: key2
params.description: Header to set within each ensemble.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Header values are calculated in double and cast to the destination header type; fractional values and out-of-range conversions affect results.
programs.difficulty_reason: It tracks changes in one header and updates another with a simple linear sequence.

test_cases.description: Reset numbering for each three-trace ensemble.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=16 ntr=9 | sushw key=cdp a=1 c=1 j=3 | susehw key1=cdp key2=cdpt a=1 b=1

test_cases.description: Use alternate headers and a decreasing sequence.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=16 ntr=8 | sushw key=fldr a=10 c=1 j=4 | susehw key1=fldr key2=tracf a=20 b=-2 verbose=1

programs.license_note: Credits say the author hacked the header-setting routine from sushw.

programs.name: sushw
programs.purpose: Set one or more trace headers from trace-number formulas or binary float values.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSHW - Set one or more Header Words using trace number, mod and

params.name: key
params.description: Headers to set. The code assigns cdp when absent but leaves nkeys at zero, so the default does not actually set a header.

params.name: infile
params.description: File of native binary floats, one value per key per trace.

params.name: j
params.description: Cycle lengths, one per key; specified zero is replaced with ULONG_MAX.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Formula evaluation uses double, floor and conversions to the destination header type; ULONG_MAX varies by platform and is converted to double. Partial binary-float reads can leave stale or uninitialized values in the input buffer.
programs.difficulty_reason: It applies simple per-trace header formulas or reads a small group of values from a file.

test_cases.description: Set two headers using cycles and shifts.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=16 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp,offset a=1,100 b=0,25 c=1,0 d=0,1 j=4,4

test_cases.description: Set headers from an SU-generated binary float file.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=8 ntr=1 | sustrip > values.bin && sunull nt=16 ntr=8 | sushw key=offset infile=values.bin

programs.name: susmoqcsv
programs.purpose: Resample and spatially average or smooth values in a 2D or 3D Q-file.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSMOQCSV - Input Q-records, alter and spatially smooth, output Q-records.

params.name: qin
params.description: Input Q-file; code does not separately check for a missing filename.

params.name: qout
params.description: Output Q-file; code passes its value to fopen without a separate missing-parameter check.

params.name: rfile
params.description: K-file containing a 3D grid; absent selects 2D.

params.name: inloc
params.description: Select input location names and coordinate system.

params.name: outind
params.description: Output first, last and increment; when supplied, missing trailing entries default to 3000 and 1000 respectively.

params.name: outlist
params.description: Explicit output independent values; mutually exclusive with outind.

params.name: navrg
params.description: Averaging half-widths; one supplied value is copied to both directions; -1 averages the whole direction.

params.name: nsmth
params.default: computed: navrg values, with -1 replaced by 0
params.description: Smoothing half-widths; one supplied value is copied to both directions.

params.name: nback
params.description: Endpoint extrapolation distances in records; one supplied value is copied to both directions.

params.name: cdpt
params.description: Output in transposed CDP order for a 3D grid.

params.name: ename
params.description: Names to exclude from input and output.

params.name: sname
params.description: Single-value names to smooth instead of copying.

params.name: cname
params.description: Tuple names to copy rather than smooth.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Double interpolation, running sums, endpoint extrapolation and sequential two-direction smoothing depend on evaluation order; lrint and decimal formatting also affect exact results. Several string allocations omit space for the terminating NUL, causing buffer overflows and undefined behavior.
programs.difficulty_reason: It manages complex Q-file tuple layouts, 2D and 3D grid mappings, interpolation, sorting and multi-stage spatial smoothing.

test_cases.description: Generate a Q-file and apply 2D averaging and smoothing.
test_cases.command: suprofcsv qout=in.q gaps=1,2,3,4,5,6 gx=0,25,50,75,100,125 gy=0,1,3,3,1,0 chordi=0 chordf=0 nmaxa=0 nmaxs=0 && susmoqcsv qin=in.q qout=out.q navrg=1 nsmth=1 nback=0 sname=gx,gy

test_cases.description: Generate a Q-file and use whole-line averaging.
test_cases.command: suprofcsv qout=in.q gaps=1,2,3,4,5,6 gx=0,25,50,75,100,125 gy=0,1,3,3,1,0 chordi=0 chordf=0 nmaxa=0 nmaxs=0 && susmoqcsv qin=in.q qout=out.q navrg=-1 nsmth=0 sname=gy formtv=%.4f

programs.license_note: The running-average routine is identified as copied from sufarldcsv.
